surface_mechanism_description: Self-limited surface reactions between TiCl4 and AlH2(tBuNCH2CH2NMe2) leading to titanium carbonitride film growth with high growth rate and low Al content.
evidence: Importantly, film growth proceeded via self-limited surface reactions, which is the hallmark of an ALD process. The films were polycrystalline with low intensity, broad reflections corresponding to the cubic TiN/TiC phase. Film composition by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy was approximately TiC0.8N0.5 at 300 °C with small amounts of Al (6 at%), Cl (4 at%) and O (4 at%) impurities.
